1
Rabba Bach Jaway Bach Jaway Veer Hussain.
Rayi Kardi Sain Duawaan Main Jiwaan Ya Mar Jawaan Mere Veer Salamat Rain.
Sang Mere Hussain Jaiyaan Haye Wich Pardais Ne Aayiyaan Jinna Wekhiyaan Ne Bas Shaiyaan.
Kadi Dukh Nayi Wekhay Aina Na E Kadi Aj Taun Pehlaan Lashaan Te Paye Wain.

2
Veer Ghazi Rawway Salamat Aye Saday Ghar Te Rehmat Aiday Naal Way Meri Himmat.
Na Aisa Wela Aaway Abbas Bhira Di Ja Te Pehrey Te Aaway Bhain.
Sham De Loki Bhul Gaye Ne Aye Jannat De Shehzaday Zahra Di Akh De Taray.
Chakiyaan Pe Pe Ke Amari Kiya Aisay Layi Palay Si Aye Teer Te Naizay Sain.

3
Main Udeekaan Habib Aaway Aj Wadah Aanr Nibhaway Mera Shabeer Bachaway.
Lakhaan Ne Wairi Aiday Sa Ruk Ruk Jawan Mere Nayi Aanda Dil Nu Chain.
Mere Veraan Ne Aithay Rehna Main Sham Shehar Tur Janra Arman Nayi Pora Hona.
Mainu Veer Mere Dafnaday Meri Turbat Aap Banaday Haye Wich Bain Al-Harmain.

4
Saday Khiyam Ghair Le Ne Te Bagi Kenday Paye Ne Aj Ummati Aye Bhul Gaye Ne.
Assi Waris Fi Al-Qurba De Assi Malik Innama De Sadi Malkiyaat Darain.
Veer De Gal Te Chaliya Khanjar Zainab Khud Takiya Manzar Mehshar Taun Pehlaan Mehshar.
Akhiyaan Wich Ewein Wasiyaan Zainab Nu Teraan Zarbaan Kadi Bhulniyaan Nayi Saqlain.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/rabba-bach-jaway-bach-jaway-veer-hussain-lyrics-punjabi-2020-tajpoints-227d88d2bb6bb6d3c9dc.md')
data = p.read_text()
data = data.replace('غازی روے سلامت', 'غازی رہوے سلامت')
p.write_text(data)
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True)
old = original.split('---', 2)[2].strip().splitlines()
front, body = data.split('---', 2)[1:]
roman = [line.strip() for line in front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].strip().splitlines()]
assert [line.rstrip('.').casefold() for line in old] == [line.casefold() for line in roman]
for edition, digits in [(front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1], '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, digit in zip(blocks, digits):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert lines[0].strip() == digit and len(lines) == 5 and all(line.strip() for line in lines)
print('Verified four aligned stanzas and 16 verses in each edition, with Roman wording preserved.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Punjabi Shahmukhi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, adjusting capitalization and removing final periods. Verified that both editions have four stanzas of four verses. Updated the titles and script metadata, and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

The Roman phrase “bas shaiyaan” is ambiguous. I rendered it phonetically as `بس شَیاں`.
